intro.name: The beginning
intro.text: (Prankster1) and (prankster2) have exchanged harmless jokes for days. Now each is determined to have the last laugh.

a1.text: One admits defeat graciously and congratulates the other.

a2.text: The reluctant elder judge announces a tie and flees.

text_only.reason: narrative: the elder hurries off; nobody leaves the village

a3.text: Both competitors are caught by their own tricks.

b1.text: The entire village laughs at a brilliantly timed surprise.

b2.text: The joke fails spectacularly and the pranksters are embarrassed.

b3.text: A valuable clay vessel is broken; the pranksters repair or replace it.

b4.text: An elaborate trick accidentally helps solve a practical problem.

c1.text: The two arrange a joyful communal celebration.

c3.text: The rivalry becomes an annual friendly tradition with clear rules.
